senses.definition: n.f. (stinking things) stinking or noxious weeds, Jb 31:40 תַּחַת חִטָּה יֵצֵא חוֹחַ וְתַחַת־שְׂעֹרָה בָאְשָׁה instead of wheat may there spring forth bramble, and instead of barley stinking weeds (cf. Assyrian bîšu Zehnpfund BAS I. 633).
